label: Ordering a DAG
subgoals: Find a vertex with in-degree zero
Fail exactly when a cycle remains

visual.title: Remove a source, then repeat
visual.caption: A topological order puts every directed edge before its target. The algorithm repeatedly removes a vertex with in-degree zero. A cycle leaves no such vertex, so the order cannot exist.

predict.question: Which vertex can start a topological order of this DAG?
options: Any vertex with the largest label
predict.explain: A source has in-degree zero and no prerequisite. Removing it may expose another source, and the process repeats.
